meta.prompt: Show five coffee shops near me as a list beside a simple drawn map (streets as lines, no map tiles) with a numbered pin for each: 1 Bean There, 4.8 stars, 0.2 mi, open 7:00 to 18:00; 2 Daily Grind, 4.6, 0.3 mi, 6:30 to 17:00; 3 Roast & Co, 4.7, 0.4 mi, 8:00 to 19:00; 4 The Steam Cup, 4.4, 0.5 mi, 7:30 to 20:00; 5 Cafe Lune, 4.5, 0.6 mi, 10:00 to 23:00. Tapping a shop or its pin highlights both and shows that shop's rating, distance and opening hours (only the chosen one's). On a narrow screen the map goes above the list.
meta.text:
ChatCard "Coffee near you" "5 shops within 0.6 mi" icon:"local_cafe" status:"Open now" tone:accent w:390
  state pick=0
  MapPanel =pick count:5
  SectionLabel "Nearby" "tap a shop or pin"
  PlaceRow "Bean There" "Coffee shop" index:1 rating:"4.8" distance:"0.2 mi" hours:"7:00 – 18:00" selected:=pick==1 -> pick=1
  PlaceRow "Daily Grind" "Coffee shop" index:2 rating:"4.6" distance:"0.3 mi" hours:"6:30 – 17:00" selected:=pick==2 -> pick=2
